summary: Frontend-only DURISE Phase-1 end-to-end tested via Playwright against public preview URL. All 18 requested behaviours verified across login gating, DPDP consent validation, roster search, patient dashboard, vascular tab timeline, history sub-tabs, telemetry stream, session stage inputs & context, prescription report engine, sign-off gating, WhatsApp mock dispatch log, engine differentiation across 3 patients, and mobile responsiveness at 390x844. Every requested data-testid resolves and behaves as specified. Two non-blocking React console issues detected (see minor issues).

code_issues_found.issue: React warning in console: 'Cannot update a component (AppProvider) while rendering a different component (TelemetryPanel)'. Some state setter (likely updateDraft or setStage) is being called during render instead of inside useEffect / event handler.
code_issues_found.impact: Does not break functionality, but is a React anti-pattern that can cause unexpected re-renders and future StrictMode errors.

code_issues_found.issue: Repeated console warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. ResponsiveContainer receives a parent with 0 width on first render (likely inside a Tabs panel that is display:none until active, or missing minWidth: 0 / explicit height).
code_issues_found.impact: Charts still render eventually, but produces console spam and a brief flash of empty chart area.

T15 Engine differentiation confirmed: Fatima (AV Graft, flow 1120) -> 'Objective achieved', vascular trend stable; Joseph (Tunnelled Catheter, flow 260) -> 'Objective at risk', trend rising -> different report text
T16 Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow on login/roster/dashboard; tab list wraps
action_items: Fix TelemetryPanel setState-in-render warning (move any updateDraft/setStage call out of render into useEffect or event handler).
Give Recharts ResponsiveContainer explicit height (e.g. h-64) or minWidth:0 on flex parent to remove width/height -1 warnings and initial flash.
critical_code_review_comments: TelemetryPanel violates React 'no setState during render' rule - see console error.
Chart containers inside Tabs panels lose measured size on first paint; wrap in a div with fixed height instead of relying on aspect ratio.

Sign-off empty-clinician branch relies on a toast (sonner) rather than an inline error - verified indirectly (no signoff-status appeared), but consider mirroring the login-error inline pattern for consistency.
test_credentials: OPR-1041 (S. Kulkarni), OPR-2276, OPR-3390 - no password, DPDP consent required. From /app/memory/test_credentials.md
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only build; use public URL https://vascular-access-ai.preview.emergentagent.com; login via [data-testid=demo-operator-OPR-1041] + [data-testid=dpdp-consent-checkbox] + [data-testid=login-submit-btn]. All flows work. Only outstanding items are the TelemetryPanel React warning and Recharts container size warnings.
rca of the issue: N/A - no functional bugs found. React warning RCA: TelemetryPanel likely invokes AppContext's updateDraft or setStage inside render body (or inside a memoized value) instead of an effect/handler.
